# ![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86988982273cb2307a4c93b5f5d6d3121b1f852d.png)

**1 Creeper Skin**

Retextures the creeper to be based on the modern Oak Leaves texture just like how the original creeper is based on the old leaves texture.

There are currently no variants yet in the pack.
